name: Solar Sail Sunflower Harbor
description: A harbor where elegant boats with giant sunflower-shaped solar sails catch golden sunlight on a sparkling sea.
prompt: A single radiant scene of a futuristic harbor at golden hour, where elegant boats have enormous sunflower-shaped solar sails that glow as they catch sunlight. The sea sparkles with amber reflections, wind turbines and a lighthouse in the distance, sailors on wooden docks. Warm cinematic light, hopeful solarpunk atmosphere, high detail, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: These sails don't just catch wind—they catch sunshine. Would you sail toward the golden horizon?
